blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The city council of Lipa, Batangas, is pushing for a government-owned and operated pet cemetery to provide deceased companion animals with a proper resting place. On Nov. 16, the city council adopted a resolution urging Mayor Eric Africa to consider establishing a local government-run Pet Memorial Park and directing concerned city offices to conduct preliminary studies, assessments, and preparations for its eventual operation. “Companion animals have become an important part of many households, providing companionship, comfort, and emotional support to their owners, who often regard them as members of their families,” the resolution stated.
